title: Mapping the Spinal Reflex Arc
description: Trace sensory afferent neurons, interneurons in the spinal cord, and motor efferents during reflex withdrawal.
problemStatement:
A person accidentally touches a scorching hot stove burner and pulls their hand back before consciously feeling the sensation of pain.

### Requirements:
1. Diagram and trace the precise neural circuitry involved in this spinal reflex arc (Sensory/Afferent Neurons -> Spinal Interneurons -> Motor/Efferent Neurons).
2. Explain why the motor withdrawal happens *before* the conscious realization of pain in the cerebral cortex.
3. Identify the role of the somatosensory cortex and the thalamus once the ascending pain signals eventually reach the brain.
hints: Hint 1: Spinal reflex loops bypass the brain entirely for rapid initial motor responses.
Hint 2: Sensory neurons enter via dorsal roots, and motor signals exit via ventral roots.
